title: Integrations: connect your accounts and move files
summary: A new Integrations page for cloud storage, social and content accounts, image steps and templates in Cosmos, translation of the text inside a document's pictures, Chat spaces, and Magic Layers and Image Creator fixes.

items.title: A new Integrations page.
items.body: Your organization's own third-party accounts now live in one place in the side rail, grouped as Social and video, Files and storage, and Websites and content.

items.title: Bring files in and save results back.
items.body: Connect Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint or Box, browse it, import files into your Drive and save results back to it. Members with the new **Use** permission can do this without being able to connect or disconnect accounts.

items.title: Social and content accounts.
items.body: Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, WordPress, Contentful, HubSpot and GitHub can be connected, and each card shows the account it signed in as.

children.body: A self-hosted WordPress site connects with its address, a username and an Application Password.

items.title: Ask for a service that isn't listed.
items.body: Request any other service by name from the page.

sections.title: Cosmos: image steps and file steps

items.title: Image steps for workflows.

children.body: Create an image from a prompt.
Adapt an image to another size or shape, such as an Instagram Story.
Turn an image into an editable, translated Magic Layers design.

items.title: Four ready-made image workflows.

children.body: Localise an image for every channel.

items.title: See the images on the run page.
items.body: A run's images show in a gallery on its page.

items.title: Import from and save to cloud storage.
items.body: New steps take a file from a connected storage account and save results back to one.

items.title: InDesign translation step.
items.body: Translate an InDesign document (.idml) through a translation memory. Frames, styles, images and master pages stay as they are.

items.title: Translate the text inside a document's pictures.
items.body: Choose **Translate text inside images** when you translate a document. Let it pick the pictures that have text, or choose them yourself: a free check ticks the ones it finds text in, and you can untick any to leave it alone (not charged) or tick one it missed.

children.body: Scanned pages and pictures that can't be redrawn are shown but can't be ticked.

items.title: Work on each picture afterwards.
items.body: The document's page lists its pictures. Open one in the image translator or in Magic Layers, or put the original back.

items.title: Find and replace in text-to-speech.
items.body: Press Cmd/Ctrl+F or **Find** to search the cards, step through matches and replace them. Replace says first when generated audio would need regenerating.

items.title: Copy or download the source and translated files
items.body: from the maximised raw output view.

items.title: Spaces.
items.body: Group chats into a space with its own instructions and memory notes, which every chat in it uses.

items.title: A clearer model picker.
items.body: Search models and see at a glance which are most capable, reasoning, balanced or fast, with their price.

items.title: Pin, rename and move chats,
items.body: into a space, a new space or out of one.

items.title: Opens with the right brand kit.
items.body: An image sent from Image Creator opens in Magic Layers with the brand kit it was made with, so its fonts load straight away.

items.title: Faster splits.
items.body: Text removal now starts alongside the object cut-outs. A split usually takes 2 to 5 minutes, longer when the AI services are busy, and the app says so.

items.title: Brand fonts fit the original.
items.body: **Use brand fonts** never sets text taller or wider than the original letters, keeps the design's line spacing, and leaves print on products, logos and screens as it is.

items.title: Stylised brand names stay logos
items.body: instead of being erased and retyped as plain text.

items.title: Saves retry on their own.
items.body: A failed autosave tries again after 3, 10 and 30 seconds, and closing the tab with unsaved changes asks first.

items.title: Image Creator: edit an area precisely.
items.body: Editing a painted area changes only that area, removes the old text fully, and keeps new text whole even when it runs past the edge.

items.title: Copy one language's overlay style to another.
items.body: **Copy style** and **Apply style** carry position, size and styling across without touching the words, so a translated tagline or a localized dealer name stays as it is.

items.title: API keys have a rate limit.
items.body: Each key allows a burst of 60 requests, refilled at one a second. Over that, requests get a 429 with a Retry-After header.

items.title: Magic Layers: some text stayed in the background,
items.body: so it showed twice: stacked price lines and white words on a coloured shape. They're now erased.

items.title: Magic Layers: **Export PNG** could fail.
items.body: It now works, shows **Exporting…** from the click, and finishes much faster.

items.title: Magic Layers: opening a text for typing changed its look.
items.body: The original letters stay in view until you change the words, and selected letters no longer turn dark.

items.title: Image Creator: a brief could show up as raw JSON,
items.body: for example after "Generate 1 image". It now shows as the brief card.

items.title: Image Creator: layout labels were printed on the image,
items.body: such as "Price lock-up:" on a banner. They're no longer printed.

items.title: Image Creator: **Adjust style** and **Regenerate** lost a custom size,
items.body: for example 1360 x 800 came back as 1376 x 768. The exact size is kept.

items.title: Image Creator: after editing one selected image, the chat offered two versions.
items.body: It now mentions only the images it made.
